observations.observation: Stable security updates can preserve the upstream version by backporting fixes; exact Debian package version, changelog and advisory determine fix state. The FAQ distinguishes stable security support from testing/unstable and unsupported proposed-updates.

An explicit archive timestamp identifies a historical repository state; unavailable exact timestamps resolve to the preceding available snapshot. Historical sources may require source-scoped check-valid-until=no. This does not waive Release signature verification.

lxml documents both a system-library source build and explicit static dependency builds. A pinned wheel/version alone does not identify every embedded library version; all-copy verification must inspect the selected binary.

Current system requirements include Node22/24/26 and Debian12/13 on x86-64 or arm64. Generic documentation does not qualify pinned alpha1.64.0/Chromium155 or prove sandbox operation on a specific host.

Official guidance recommends a separate non-root user and seccomp namespace permissions for untrusted browser content, pinning images and matching client/server versions. Development advice that adds SYS_ADMIN or uses host IPC is not authority to widen Meri's approved isolation controls.
